summary: Elasticsearch News index synchronization
text: Synchronised the news search index when news is added, edited, deleted or its category is renamed. News search results stay in step with news changes.

summary: Global search: search request can contain only spaces
text: Blocked global searches made of spaces only. Empty or whitespace-only searches don't run.

summary: No action on the front with search query for 1 latter
text: Stopped the frontend showing a search in progress for one-letter queries. Typing one letter does nothing.

summary: Elastic is on by default for all new events
text: Turned Elasticsearch search on by default for new events, while clones keep their source settings. New events use Elasticsearch search.

summary: Include Exhibitor as multiplicator and indexes for Products and Brands
text: Let brand search match the exhibitor name, returning brands the exhibitor owns or sells. Searching an exhibitor's name finds its brands and products.

summary: Change the names and order of the multiplicators
text: Renamed and reordered search multiplicators in the admin panel, putting name, description and category first. Search weighting settings are clearer and consistently ordered.

summary: Check and fix a design on the Recommendations page
text: Checked and fixed the responsive design of the Recommendations page. Recommendations display correctly across screen sizes.

summary: Include Exhibitor as multiplicator and indexes for Exhibitor Events
text: Added exhibitor name as a search multiplicator for exhibitor events. Exhibitor events can be found by exhibitor name.

summary: Search should be done by activity categories for delegates, buyers and speakers
text: Made search match activity categories for delegates, buyers and speakers. People search covers activity categories.

summary: Sync tasks for Elasticsearch to queue
text: Moved all Elasticsearch sync tasks to a dedicated queue. Search sync runs through its own queue.

summary: Permission matrix filters delegate list for the search
text: Applied the permission matrix's view settings to delegate, speaker and buyer search results. Search hides people the permission matrix says users can't see.

summary: Include the name of the speaker to the session as multiplicator
text: Added speaker name to the session search index and as a search multiplicator. Sessions can be found and weighted by speaker name.

summary: Create additional index in process of syncing the whole event
text: Built a new search index during full event syncs and swapped it in, instead of updating the live index. Search keeps working while an event re-syncs.

summary: Exhibitor name (Exhibitor events) should be searched via elastic
text: Moved exhibitor name search for exhibitor events to Elasticsearch and made it a search multiplicator. Exhibitor events are searched by exhibitor name through Elasticsearch.

summary: Ignore stop-words for objects
text: Made search ignore English stop-words for all stage-two global search objects. Words like 'the' or 'and' no longer skew search across exhibitors, people, sessions, news and groups.

summary: Add ability to drag chatbot icon in the admin panel
text: Made the admin panel chatbot icon draggable. Admins can move the chatbot icon out of the way.

summary: Android/ Improvement  logic of recommended sections
text: Applied networking opt-in and permission matrix visibility to recommended sections and lists in the Android app. Android recommendations only show people and items users may see.

summary: Remove key fromRecomendation in the news page
text: Removed the fromRecommendation flag from the news page URL after arriving from a recommendation. News URLs stay clean after following a recommendation.

summary: Saving chat while moving thoughout the new front
text: Kept the AI chat and its results in the widget while users move around the new frontend. The AI conversation persists until the widget is closed or the page refreshed.

summary: Android/ Search results UPDATE behaviour
text: Kept Android search results when returning from a profile. Android users return to their search results.

summary: Recommendation 500 error
text: Fixed a 500 error on the recommendations endpoint so recommendations, including groups, load. The Recommendations page shows its lists.

summary: Change default state of category select on the recommendations page in the admin panel
text: Set recommendation block categories to 'Available for all' by default in the admin panel. Recommendation blocks show to everyone unless restricted.

summary: Save widgets link on in the recommendation news list
text: Kept the /widgets path when opening news from recommendations inside widgets. Widget navigation stays in widget mode.

summary: Android/ Add pls "roles" icons on "Recommended" sections ( Recommended page/ Visitors page/ Speakers page)
text: Added role icons to Android recommended sections on the Recommended, Visitors and Speakers pages. Android recommendations show role icons.

summary: Database Setup for new Recommendation Service
text: Designed the database for the new recommendation service's embeddings and distances, with multi-tenancy. The recommender has a defined data store.

summary: Implement calculation of Matching Score and providing recommendations via API
text: Implemented matching score calculation and recommendations via API for the new recommendation service. Recommendations are scored from category embeddings.

summary: Infrastructure on AWS for new Recommendation System
text: Selected and provisioned AWS infrastructure for the new recommendation service as code. The recommender runs on purpose-built infrastructure.

summary: Expand Search to Include Descriptions - Mobile App
text: Extended app search to match descriptions as well as titles for exhibitors, sessions, events, products and speakers. App search finds more relevant results.

summary: Global Search. Improve current search field to be global
text: Turned the header search into a global search with a category selector, plus admin settings for search categories and icon colour. Users search everything from one field and choose a category.

summary: Global Search. Unified Global Search page
text: A unified Global Search results page: an 'All categories' search shows blocks per content type (exhibitors, products, sessions, speakers and more). Searching all categories opens one page with a total count, a carousel per type and Show more links into each listing.

summary: Global Search. Top results
text: A Top results row on the new Global Search page showing up to 10 of the most relevant matches across all content types. Search results open with the ten most relevant cards in one row, ordered only by relevance.

summary: Global Search. Save query
text: Logged-in users can save Global Search queries (up to 20), pick one to re-run it instantly, and delete them. Saved searches appear by the search field and follow the user across devices.

summary: Global Search. Search field with suggestions
text: Autocomplete for the global search field: from the second character it suggests up to 10 queries from the client's search history, with typo tolerance. Clicking a suggestion runs the search straight away; suggestions are ranked by how often they're searched.

summary: Enable filtering on DS side for marketplace filters
text: Marketplace filters are applied on the data-science search side, so search results come back already filtered by the active filters. Search and filters work together on marketplace listings.

summary: Global Search. Quick links, Show all, and Back navigation
text: Quick links and Show all buttons on the Global Search page open a category listing with the query applied, with a Back button to return. Users move between the unified results and filtered listings without losing their search.

summary: Global search. UI improvements based on feedback from IMEX
text: Global Search results page refinements: a fixed search field under the banner, counts on Show all buttons, a bold results title, even News cards. The results page is cleaner, counts match their sections, and sponsored blocks are renamed Sponsored Exhibitors and Sponsored Products.

summary: Global Search. Blocks, Labels, Order and Availability Control
text: Organisers control which Global Search options, quick links, menu items and result blocks appear, and their order, in Website Builder; labels move to Translation Manager. Round Tables and On-demand join the options; Buyers and Delegates appear only to viewers allowed to see them.

summary: Cancel button for exports
text: Added a cancel button so organisers can stop any export manually. Organisers can cancel a running export.

summary: Edit refresh logic in all checkQueueExportStatus
text: Fixed the refresh flag in export status checks so polling continues until the file URL is ready. Export status endpoints report refresh correctly until the download is ready.

summary: Refactor of messages export file. Transfere file data source from dynamo db to clickhouse
text: Moved the messages export data source from DynamoDB to ClickHouse and refactored the export. Message exports read from ClickHouse.

summary: Interactions scores fix. Default values after enabling.
text: Created default interaction scores when a client or event is created or interaction scores are switched on. Interaction scores start with defaults instead of empty values.

summary: Unique logins for the report
text: Changed the mobile app logins report to keep only each user's latest login and renamed it Unique Mobile App logins. The export lists each user once with their latest mobile login.

summary: Move all total stat tables dynamo data to 1 clickhouse table
text: Moved all total-statistics DynamoDB tables into one ClickHouse table. Total statistics live in a single ClickHouse table.

summary: Set informer "excel generation..." instead of "in progress 100%" if uploading data to excel in progress
text: Showed 'excel generation…' once export data is ready and the Excel file is being written. Users see that the Excel file is being generated.

summary: Analytics: ui issues
text: Fixed analytics tab UI gaps against the design: avatars, device filter, tooltips, bubbles, icons, totals and colours. The admin analytics tab matches the design.

summary: meeting export improvement
text: Improved the meeting export so it no longer freezes. Meeting exports complete.

summary: Check-in export: optimize database query
text: Optimised the check-in export query that ran thousands of times. Check-in exports use far fewer queries.

summary: Logs export rework (API public + admin logs)
text: Queued public API log and admin log exports. Log exports run through a queue.

summary: Including column Scanned code in the check-in report
text: Added a Scanned code column to the check-in report. The check-in report shows the code scanned at check-in.

summary: Indentifying the uniqueness of check-in for non-EP users
text: Identified unique check-ins for people not in the platform by the scanned code, and for registered users by account ID. Check-in uniqueness is counted for everyone.

summary: Need to fix incorrect Interactions table width CSS property for Visitors
text: Fixed the width of the visitor dashboard Interactions table. The Interactions table displays at the right width.

summary: optimize "Custom Meeting Report" export based on automation test data
text: Optimised the Custom Meeting Report export, also improving the meetings export. Meeting reports export faster.

summary: Hide leaderboard if we pick All for the events
text: Hid the meetings leaderboards when All events is selected in analytics. The Meetings tab matches the dashboard behaviour for all events.

summary: Add a comma for 4+-digits numbers
text: Added thousand separators to numbers in the analytics Meetings tab. Large numbers read as 1,000 and 1,000,000.

summary: Create dropdown menu for sources
text: Added a Mobile app / Web platform dropdown to the analytics sources chart. Organisers can view traffic sources by app or web.

summary: Only confirmed meetings should be counted for uniqueness of participant
text: Counted unique meeting participants only from confirmed meetings, with an explanatory tooltip. The unique participants metric reflects confirmed meetings only.

summary: Change the name of the metrics
text: Renamed the Avg. time on site metric to Avg. time online. The users page shows Avg. time online.

summary: Refactoring of "Top performers dashboard" with logic rework
text: Reworked the exhibitor dashboard Top performers block with consistent exhibitor and team member stats for meetings, chats and scans. Top performers shows consistent stats by timeframe.

summary: Meetings export: not completed on alpha
text: Fixed a meetings export that didn't complete on a test environment. The meetings export completes.

summary: Correct module for Check-in analytics
text: Kept a single Check-in module that controls the check-in analytics tab. Switching off Check-in hides the check-in tab.

summary: Supply and demand graph | Display all categories by the same values
text: Changed the supply and demand graph tooltip to list all categories that share the same values. Grouped categories are listed clearly in one tooltip.

summary: Change the name Total Meetings Appointed on App Data
text: Renamed Total Meetings Appointed to Total Meetings Requested on the App data page. The metric name matches what it counts.

summary: Move ExpoStatDB to Universal
text: Moved the stats database helper to the universal layer and removed the backend copy. Notification counters use one shared helper.

summary: Fix analytic app data page refresh
text: Fixed the analytics App data tab refreshing randomly. Analytics tabs stay put.

summary: Add exhibitor_role enam to account_events table
text: Added an exhibitor role enum (owner, admin, team member) to account events. Exhibitor roles are stored consistently.

summary: Data in PostgresQL and Clickhouse to be the same
text: Sent badge scans, favourites and session and meeting attendees to ClickHouse, with a nightly job to fix discrepancies. Analytics data matches the main database.

summary: Registration Incomplete export rework
text: Reworked the Registration Incomplete export to run through SQS. The incomplete registrations export runs as a queued job.

summary: Logic of displaying of how the Total meetings graph
text: Made the Total meetings graph count meetings by creation date. The graph uses one consistent date.

summary: Team Member Export File - Addition of a new column "External QR"
text: Added an External QR column to the team member export. Team member exports include external QR codes.

summary: Investigate BI tool selection for new analytics
text: Investigated BI tools for the new analytics against ClickHouse support, security, visualisation, integration, cost and collaboration. BI tool options were compared.

summary: Development <first> dashboard - for demo to Informa
text: Built a first analytics dashboard for a demo: login counts, total, web and app, over time. A login analytics dashboard was ready to demo.

summary: Adding a column for "is_new" field to the exhibitor export file
text: An 'Is New' column in the exhibitor export, filled yes or no from the exhibitor's 'Is New' setting. Organisers can export which exhibitors are marked new, alone or with all fields.

summary: Meeting program. Report. All meetings tab. Add extra column about meeting generation
text: A Source column in the Meeting Program report's All Meetings tab: 1st generation, 2nd generation or Manual. Reports show whether each meeting came from the algorithm's first or second run or was added by the organiser.

summary: Meeting Program Report — Meeting Ratings in All Meetings Tab
text: The Meeting Program report's All Meetings tab shows each side's rating score, reason and 'did not take place' flag for confirmed meetings. Organisers review ratings per meeting, with empty cells where no rating was given.

summary: Profile Completion Column in Export Reports (Participants)
text: The Visitor, Team member and Speaker exports gain a Profile completion column, matching what each participant sees on their dashboard. Exports show the same profile-completion value as the frontend.

summary: Attendance: Organizer can compare Check-ins across co-located Events and view Crossover Check-ins in Total Check-In / Check-Out graph
text: Check-in analytics include badges from other EP events and unidentified external badges, with a new Event filter on each chart. Organisers see totals matching the export and can compare check-ins by badge origin across co-located events.

summary: Restoring Google Analytics Support: Enhancements for GA4 Integration and Validation
text: Google Analytics works again with GA4: the admin ID field validates the G- format, flags old UA IDs, and the site loads GA4 with the saved ID. Organisers track their event website in GA4; nothing loads when the ID is empty or invalid.

summary: Enhancing Meetings report and Custom Meeting Wizard Report: Adding Business Transaction Likelihood and Meeting Did Not Take Place Columns
text: The Meetings report and Custom Meeting Wizard report gain Business Transaction Likelihood (0–10) and Meeting Did Not Take Place columns. Exports include both columns for every rated meeting, including ratings submitted before the release.

summary: Remove unnecessary socket call for unauthorized user "chatsList"
text: Removed an unnecessary chat list socket call for users who aren't logged in. Guests no longer trigger chat socket requests.

summary: Create setting for using custom SMPT service
text: Added a setting to send platform emails through a custom SMTP service. Registration, meeting, message, campaign and reminder emails can use a custom SMTP server.

summary: View of the cards in the emails
text: Fixed product and exhibitor cards in emails: no underline, left-aligned names, buttons on the right, sponsor icons with a count. Email nurturing cards match the design.

summary: Notification refactoring
text: Refactored platform notifications. Notifications were reworked; notifications for users who aren't logged in were left to a later task.

summary: Decrease the size of the incoming messages variable
text: Made the incoming messages email variable more compact: one line of message, date closer to sender. The incoming messages block matches the email nurturing design.

summary: Implement templates for all events
text: Made the six email nurturing campaign templates default for every event, old and new, with default banner and footer. Every event has six ready campaign templates in its template list.

summary: Adjust the outlook of the variable
text: Refined meeting and message email variables: tighter spacing, truncated names, two rows on mobile, real attendee photos. Incoming meeting and message blocks look right on desktop and mobile.

summary: Setting for determining the number of messages
text: Added a setting for how many messages, up to ten, appear in the incoming messages email variable. Organisers choose how many messages appear in nurturing emails.

summary: Filter for the search query in Group tab
text: Showed the active search term and filters as chips on the Groups tab. Groups show what the user is searching or filtering by.

summary: Hide Export data if there was no send-out
text: Hid Export data for campaign send-outs that haven't happened yet. Export data appears only for completed send-outs.

summary: [Groups] Rework participants adding to chuncks.
text: Sent group invitations in chunks when inviting many people. Large group invitations complete.

summary: Notifications. Exhibitor three dots menu. Styles looks wrong
text: Fixed the styles of the exhibitor actions menu in notifications. The notifications menu displays properly.

summary: Refactor sending admin notifications
text: Sent admin notifications in batches through a queue. Admin notifications send reliably at scale.

summary: iOS/ Add event_id param to unsetPushToken request
text: Added the event ID to the iOS unset push token request, sent on every event change in multi-event apps. Push tokens are unset for the right event.

summary: Leader board | Change the text of the tooltips
text: Rewrote the Leader dashboard tooltips for average interaction metrics. Tooltips explain each average clearly.

summary: Click on the logo of exhibitor doesn't work in the mini chat
text: Fixed the exhibitor logo in a new mini chat opening a participant page. The logo opens the exhibitor.

summary: Create logs on Cloudwatch for manual emails
text: Rebuilt CloudWatch logs for exhibitor manual emails after architecture changes. Manual emails are traceable.

summary: [portalUI] add ability to click on the notification in the notification dropdown menu
text: Made notifications in the dropdown menu clickable to open the related profile or session. Users jump from a notification to its subject.

summary: fix src/components/UI/actionButtons/messageButton/MessageButton.tsx
text: Fixed message button colours in the custom listing table to follow the builder. Table buttons match the design.

summary: Replace button with IconButton for mobile devices in MessengerSendInput.tsx
text: Used an icon button for sending messages on mobile. The mobile messenger input matches the design.

summary: Messenger. Conversation status filters
text: A Conversation Status filter in Messenger: All, Two-way (both sides have written) or One-way (only one side has). Users filter their chats by reply status, combined with the existing filters.

summary: lead questions: remove copy-paste blocks
text: Removed duplicated copy-paste blocks from the lead questions script. The lead questions script has no duplicated blocks.

summary: lead questions: add logging
text: Added logging to the lead questions functionality. Lead questions activity is logged.

summary: Find and fix mass product category update (elastic)
text: Found and fixed mass product category updates in the search index. Bulk product category changes reach search correctly.

summary: /admin/exhibitormanual/viewSubmission/1629 | /expo_backend/public/admin.php
text: Fixed the exhibitor manual submission view calling a download method on a result set. Manual submissions with documents open in the admin panel.

summary: The possibility to upload all exhibitors including the ones without the category
text: Added an Exhibitor header option that selects all exhibitors, including those without a category. Organisers can target all exhibitors at once.

summary: ManualTask deadlineAction no exhibitors error
text: Fixed the exhibitor manual deadline task failing when no exhibitors match. Manual deadline reminders run without errors.

summary: Check only updated fields of Product while sync to Elasticsearch
text: Synced exhibitors and products to search only when their searchable fields change. Fewer unnecessary search syncs.

summary: Sync to Elasticsearch only in the end of importing products
text: Paused search syncing during product imports and synced once at the end. Imports trigger a single search sync.

summary: Rewrite in the manual suppliers state to the hook
text: Moved exhibitor manual supplier state into a reusable hook with its own interface. Supplier state is handled by a shared hook.

summary: Remove duplicated queries from Marketplace page
text: Removed duplicated queries from the marketplace page. The marketplace page makes fewer queries.

summary: Sponsors and sponsored products cards are 6 in a raw
text: Showed six sponsor and sponsored product cards per row and renamed Sponsors to Sponsored Products on the products page. Sponsor rows show six cards; the products page says Sponsored Products.

summary: Sponsor exhibitors/products optimization for apps
text: Added sponsor flag and sponsor order attributes to exhibitor and product objects for the apps. The apps can show sponsored exhibitors and products in order.

summary: Add check of the toggle "Do not allow active products" state change when saving exhibitor category settings
text: Saved the 'Do not allow active products' permission only when that toggle actually changes. Unchanged toggles keep their permission.

summary: Sponsors block for exhibitor and product list in app.
text: Added a sponsors slider above the exhibitor and product lists in the app, matching the web, with sponsor limits, colours and ordering from the admin panel. The app shows sponsored exhibitors and products in their own slider.

summary: Remove "Enable required fields" check for "Required Marketing content" and "Requried video" settings
text: Made 'Enable required fields', 'Required video' and 'Required marketing content' independent, each redirecting users to fill the missing item after login, in a set priority. Organisers can require fields, a video or marketing content separately.

summary: Filter all duplicated of scans
text: Filtered duplicate scans, same barcode and time, out of the exhibitor scanned contacts report. The scanned contacts report has no duplicates.

summary: Meet button on the exhibitor card doesn't work
text: Fixed the Meet button on exhibitor cards in mobile view. Meet works on exhibitor cards on phones.

summary: Change sponsors endpoints
text: Renamed sponsor statistics endpoints and checked sponsor popup, card and banner statistics. Sponsor and banner statistics use dedicated endpoints.

summary: Sponsors stats should count only the sponsors that we have on the screen
text: Counted sponsor and sponsored product views only when they're visible in the slider, pausing it off-screen. Sponsor statistics reflect sponsors people actually saw.

summary: The clicks should be counted in the sponsor stats
text: Counted clicks on sponsor and sponsored product cards in search statistics. Sponsor statistics include clicks.

summary: Refactoring: Transfer Business Logic from Controller to Service for 'Parent Child'
text: Moved parent/child exhibitor business logic from the controller into a ParentChildService. Parent/child logic lives in a service.
